title: 第023章 我叶家人也是你们能动的第024章 十息时间足以斩杀尔等
content_zh:
“叶龙，这一场考核，我赌你叶家全部淘汰，你可敢赌？”当这些少年消失后，此地显得有些无聊，但却听得齐刀声音响起。
此声，响彻四方！
又赌？
叶龙的眸子内闪烁着一丝冷冽：“你要赌什么？”
齐刀大笑：“我知若是赌其他的你叶家未必敢，今日就赌一条胳膊，你可敢？”
赌一条胳膊？
这让不少人凝神。
此时，不少的修炼者也看向叶龙。
如今齐家这般开口，叶家是否敢？
叶龙也随之蹙眉，但这时，叶家的一位执事却是神色一凝旋即道：“长老，炎儿刚才临走时让我将此信交给你！”
一封信？
炎儿写的！
这让叶龙一惊，旋即打开。
“无论何人与您赌，应允下来，我一定带着叶家走出幻境！”
信上也只有这一句话而已。
“炎儿！”叶龙看后，喃喃道，他对叶炎有着极度的信心。
旋即他猛然抬头看向齐刀：“我叶家有何不敢？既你想赌，奉陪到底！”
什么？
看台上很多修炼者一怔，叶家竟是赌了？
“这岂不是找死？”

“叶家毫无胜算啊！”
“叶然、叶童两位也是叶家的天才，但实力绝不会达到结丹境，而无论是齐家亦或是方家皆有结丹境，可以说……叶家必败！”
很多人喃喃。
这时，方凌也随之一笑：“叶龙，我方家也想一赌，也赌一条胳膊！”
叶龙大笑：“好，我叶家全部接下！”
什么？
不少人愕然。
又接下来了？
“呵呵！”
这般下，无论是方凌亦或是齐刀全都是冷笑一声。
叶龙若失去两条胳膊，那铲除叶家便是更容易了。
至于叶家输了若不认账？
众目睽睽之下，由不得叶家如何！
何况，城主府苍圣可在此！
“叶龙疯了吗？”
“看样子是了，叶家之人难不成嗜赌成性？”
content_en:
"Ye Long, I bet that all the Ye family will be eliminated in this assessment. Do you dare to bet?" After these teenagers disappeared, the place seemed a little boring, but the sound of Qi Dao could be heard.
This sound resounded everywhere!
Bet again?
Ye Long's eyes flashed with a hint of coldness: "What are you betting on?"
Qi Dao laughed: "I know that your Ye family may not dare to bet on others, but today I will bet on an arm. Do you dare?"
Bet on an arm?
This made many people pay attention.
At this time, many practitioners also looked at Ye Long.
Now that the Qi family is talking like this, does the Ye family dare?
Ye Long also frowned, but at this time, a deacon of the Ye family looked calm and said immediately: "Elder, Yan'er asked me to give this letter to you before he left!"
A letter?
Written by Yan'er!
This surprised Ye Long and he opened it immediately.
"No matter who bets with you, if you promise, I will take the Ye family out of the illusion!"
This is the only sentence in the letter.
"Yan'er!" Ye Long muttered after looking at it. He had extreme confidence in Ye Yan.
Immediately, he suddenly raised his head and looked at Qi Dao: "Why don't we, the Ye family, dare not? Since you want to bet, I will accompany you to the end!"
What?
Many practitioners in the stands were startled. Did the Ye family actually make a bet?
"Isn't this looking for death?"
"The Ye family has no chance of winning!"
"Ye Ran and Ye Tong are also geniuses of the Ye family, but their strength will never reach the level of pill formation. Both the Qi family and the Fang family have the level of pill formation. It can be said that... the Ye family will definitely lose!"
Many people murmured.
At this time, Fang Ling also smiled: "Ye Long, our Fang family also wants to bet, and bet an arm too!"
Ye Long laughed: "Okay, my Ye family will take them all!"
What?
Many people were stunned.
Next?
"Haha!"
At this moment, both Fang Ling and Qi Dao sneered.
If Ye Long loses both arms, it will be easier to eradicate the Ye family.
As for what if the Ye family refuses to admit their defeat?
Under the gaze of everyone, there is no telling what happened to the Ye family!
What's more, Cang Shengke, the city lord's palace, is here!
"Is Ye Long crazy?"
"It seems so. Is it possible that the Ye family is addicted to gambling?"
